{"id":"3c5dc944-7c9f-4436-94b0-b015c9b9525a","type":"TABLE","label":"Validation Table","tableName":"validation","msId":"13e95cea-d298-4330-b9c6-aef964f03439","entityId":"46196b66-85e9-4be0-9522-4dbeaa780b02","dbNodeId":"7a145069-233d-4ea7-beea-f3784df3f2b3","position":{"x":610.4747124293244,"y":1268.0995340405875},"size":{"w":220,"h":160},"aiPrompt":{"description":"","businessRules":"","edgeCases":"","expectedBehaviour":"","aiGenerate":false},"customQueries":[{"id":"1874f509-a7f3-4807-80cf-4d88114f19e1","methodName":"listAll","description":"Dynamically builds and executes a paginated, filterable, sortable query over the validation table based on a recursive FilterGroup, optional global search key, and explicit search field IDs.","targetEntityId":"46196b66-85e9-4be0-9522-4dbeaa780b02","type":"AI","queryString":null,"aiPrompt":{"description":"Generate a dynamic JPA Criteria (or Specification) query that returns a Page<Validation> filtered by a recursive FilterGroup tree, narrowed by an optional global searchKey across the field IDs listed in searchBy, sorted by the SortCriteria list, and paginated using the Pagination input.","businessRules":"INPUTS
- filter: FilterGroup { logicalOp: AND|OR, conditions: FilterCondition[], filters: FilterGroup[] } — recursive. May be null/empty (no filtering).
- FilterCondition { field: UUID (Field id, resolves to a column on Validation), operator: EQ|NEQ|GT|GTE|LT|LTE|IN|NOT_IN|LIKE|IS_NULL|IS_NOT_NULL, value: any }.
- searchBy: UUID[] of Field ids. When searchKey is non-blank, build an OR of LIKE '%searchKey%' over only these fields. If searchBy is empty/null, ignore searchKey.
- searchKey: free-text. Trim; treat blank as absent.
- sorting: SortCriteria[] { field: UUID, direction: ASC|DESC }. Apply in order. Ignore unknown field ids.
- pagination: Pagination { page (0-based), page_size }. Required. Defaults: page=0, page_size=20. Cap page_size at 100.

VALIDATION ENTITY COLUMNS
- name (STRING, UNIQUE, NOT NULL)
- type (ENUM, NOT NULL)
- value (STRING, NULLABLE)
- predicate_id (FK → predicate.id, NULLABLE)
- id (UUID, PK)
- created_at, updated_at (auditing enabled)

TRANSLATION RULES
- Resolve every field UUID to its Validation column via the Field registry (name → column). If a UUID does not resolve, skip that condition (do not throw).
- Combine all entries inside a single FilterGroup (its conditions AND its nested filters) using the group's logicalOp.
- Recurse into nested filters. Each nested group is wrapped in its own parentheses before being combined with the parent group's logicalOp.
- Operator mapping: EQ →= , NEQ →<>, GT →>, GTE →>=, LT →<, LTE →<=, IN →IN (...), NOT_IN →NOT IN (...), LIKE →LIKE '%value%' (escape % and _), IS_NULL →IS NULL (no value), IS_NOT_NULL →IS NOT NULL (no value).
- IN / NOT_IN expect an array value; reject single scalar by skipping that condition.
- LIKE only valid for STRING/TEXT columns (name, value); for non-string columns, skip.
- The global searchKey filter is composed as (col1 LIKE :k OR col2 LIKE :k OR ...) over searchBy and AND-ed with the FilterGroup root.
- Always use bound parameters — never inline literals. Sanitize % and _ in LIKE values.
- Apply sorting AFTER filtering. If sorting is empty, default to ORDER BY created_at DESC (auditing is enabled on Validation).","edgeCases":"- Null filter / empty conditions and filters → no WHERE clause from filter tree.
- An empty FilterGroup nested in a parent → emit nothing for that node, do not produce '() AND ...'.
- searchBy non-empty but searchKey blank → ignore search entirely.
- searchKey non-blank but searchBy empty → ignore search entirely (do not full-table LIKE).
- IS_NULL / IS_NOT_NULL must ignore the value field even if present.
- IN / NOT_IN with empty array → skip the condition (do not generate 'IN ()' which is invalid SQL).
- Unknown operator or unresolvable field UUID → skip that condition silently and log at DEBUG.
- Mixing AND and OR is handled purely via grouping — never flatten nested groups.
- page < 0 → clamp to 0. page_size <= 0 → use default 20.
- LIKE values: escape '%', '_', '\\' before binding; use ESCAPE '\\' in the predicate.
- Type coercion: convert FilterCondition.value to the column's Java type (UUID for predicate_id, enum for type, String for name/value) before binding; if coercion fails, skip the condition.
- Always count with the same predicate tree applied — never return a stale total.","expectedBehaviour":"Given the example input { logicalOp: AND, conditions: [ {status,EQ,'active'}, {age,GTE,18} ], filters: [ { logicalOp: OR, conditions: [ {role,IN,['admin','mod']}, {country,EQ,'IN'} ], filters: [] } ] } the generated WHERE clause must be exactly: (status = :p1 AND age >= :p2) AND (role IN (:p3) OR country = :p4). Result is a Page<Validation> respecting pagination, sorting, and an accurate total count. No SQL injection is possible — all values are bound parameters.","aiGenerate":true},"params":[{"name":"searchBy","type":"ARRAY","arraySubType":"UUID","isCollection":true},{"name":"searchKey","type":"STRING","isCollection":false},{"name":"sorting","type":"ARRAY","arraySubType":"CUSTOM_TYPE_REF","arrayCustomTypeId":"fffaafe2-d788-40dd-a5d5-eb8801d7b747","isCollection":true},{"name":"pagination","type":"CUSTOM_TYPE_REF","customTypeId":"a1712799-76db-42f1-b65a-579cca8e3cbc","isCollection":false},{"name":"filter","type":"CUSTOM_TYPE_REF","customTypeId":"474532fa-3cbd-4c69-903c-2ac925a80a42","isCollection":false}],"returnType":{"entityId":"46196b66-85e9-4be0-9522-4dbeaa780b02","isList":false,"isPage":true,"isOptional":false,"projectionClass":""},"nativeQuery":false,"modifying":false,"cache":null}]}

- filter: FilterGroup { logicalOp: AND|OR, conditions: FilterCondition[], filters: FilterGroup[] } — recursive. May be null/empty (no filtering).
- FilterCondition { field: UUID (Field id, resolves to a column on Predicate), operator: EQ|NEQ|GT|GTE|LT|LTE|IN|NOT_IN|LIKE|IS_NULL|IS_NOT_NULL, value: any }.
- searchBy: UUID[] of Field ids. When searchKey is non-blank, build an OR of LIKE '%searchKey%' over only these fields. If searchBy is empty/null, ignore searchKey.
- searchKey: free-text. Trim; treat blank as absent.
- sorting: SortCriteria[] { field: UUID, direction: ASC|DESC }. Apply in order. Ignore unknown field ids.
- pagination: Pagination { page (0-based), page_size }. Required. Defaults: page=0, page_size=20. Cap page_size at 100.

TRANSLATION RULES
- Resolve every field UUID to its Predicate column via the Field registry (name → column). If a UUID does not resolve, skip that condition (do not throw).
- Combine all entries inside a single FilterGroup (its conditions AND its nested filters) using the group's logicalOp.
- Recurse into nested filters. Each nested group is wrapped in its own parentheses before being combined with the parent group's logicalOp.
- Operator mapping: EQ →= , NEQ →<>, GT →>, GTE →>=, LT →<, LTE →<=, IN →IN (...), NOT_IN →NOT IN (...), LIKE →LIKE '%value%' (escape % and _), IS_NULL →IS NULL (no value), IS_NOT_NULL →IS NOT NULL (no value).
- IN / NOT_IN expect an array value; reject single scalar by skipping that condition.
- LIKE only valid for STRING/TEXT columns; for non-string columns, skip.
- The global searchKey filter is composed as (col1 LIKE :k OR col2 LIKE :k OR ...) over searchBy and AND-ed with the FilterGroup root.
- Always use bound parameters — never inline literals. Sanitize % and _ in LIKE values.
- Apply sorting AFTER filtering. If sorting is empty, default to ORDER BY created_at DESC (auditing is enabled on Predicate).

RESULT
- Return Page<Predicate> using PageRequest.of(page, page_size, Sort).
- The total count must respect filters (use the same Specification on the count query).","edgeCases":"- Null filter / empty conditions and filters → no WHERE clause from filter tree.
- An empty FilterGroup nested in a parent → emit nothing for that node, do not produce '() AND ...'.
- searchBy non-empty but searchKey blank → ignore search entirely.
- searchKey non-blank but searchBy empty → ignore search entirely (do not full-table LIKE).
- IS_NULL / IS_NOT_NULL must ignore the value field even if present.
- IN / NOT_IN with empty array → skip the condition (do not generate 'IN ()' which is invalid SQL).
- Unknown operator or unresolvable field UUID → skip that condition silently and log at DEBUG.
- Mixing AND and OR is handled purely via grouping — never flatten nested groups.
- page < 0 → clamp to 0. page_size <= 0 → use default 20.
- LIKE values: escape '%', '_', '\\' before binding; use ESCAPE '\\' in the predicate.
- Type coercion: convert FilterCondition.value to the column's Java type (UUID, Integer, LocalDate, enum) before binding; if coercion fails, skip the condition.
- Always count with the same predicate tree applied — never return a stale total.","expectedBehaviour":"Given the example input { logicalOp: AND, conditions: [ {status,EQ,'active'}, {age,GTE,18} ], filters: [ { logicalOp: OR, conditions: [ {role,IN,['admin','mod']}, {country,EQ,'IN'} ], filters: [] } ] } the generated WHERE clause must be exactly: (status = :p1 AND age >= :p2) AND (role IN (:p3) OR country = :p4). Result is a Page<Predicate> respecting pagination, sorting, and an accurate total count. No SQL injection is possible — all values are bound parameters.","aiGenerate":true},"params":[{"name":"searchBy","type":"ARRAY","arraySubType":"UUID","isCollection":true},{"name":"searchKey","type":"STRING","isCollection":false},{"name":"sorting","type":"ARRAY","arraySubType":"CUSTOM_TYPE_REF","arrayCustomTypeId":"fffaafe2-d788-40dd-a5d5-eb8801d7b747","isCollection":true},{"name":"pagination","type":"CUSTOM_TYPE_REF","customTypeId":"a1712799-76db-42f1-b65a-579cca8e3cbc","isCollection":false},{"name":"filter","type":"CUSTOM_TYPE_REF","customTypeId":"474532fa-3cbd-4c69-903c-2ac925a80a42","isCollection":false}],"returnType":{"entityId":"f0e36cbf-703b-473f-a34c-e3824ab12b42","isList":false,"isPage":true,"isOptional":false,"projectionClass":""},"nativeQuery":false,"modifying":false,"cache":null}]}
